messages:
Maria Gomez: Kicking off onboarding for Cedar Health — internal roll call before we loop in their team. Posting stakeholders, 30-day success criteria, and proposed timeline. Quick sync tomorrow 9:00am PST?
Jae Kim: +1 for 9am. Who will own enablement session and sample prompts?
Tom Reynolds: I can own the technical walkthrough and embeddings demo. Need to confirm model variant and expected QPS.
Lina Patel: I’ll handle success criteria and 1:1 enablement. High-level 30d goals: 1) baseline integration demo with API + webhooks, 2) 5 sample prompts validated, 3) health check dashboard visible to customer.
Maria Gomez: Great. Stakeholders to know: Rajesh (Cedar Sr. PM) — primary contact, Priya (data eng) — integration lead. Internal owners: Lina (CSM), Tom (SE), Jae (enablement).
Jae Kim: Adding risk flags: renewal risk if no production traffic by day 30 OR if security review blocks private deployment. We should schedule an early security touch with eng-security if they hint at on-prem.
Tom Reynolds: Technical timeline suggestion: Day 0–3: creds + test account; Day 4–10: integration + embedding mapping; Day 11–18: validation + perf tests; Day 19–30: enablement + rollout support.
Lina Patel: Success criteria (short): - End-to-end demo running on test data - 5 validated prompts with quality score >= 0.8 - Key metric: median latency < 500ms on demo traffic
Maria Gomez: Can we surface any capacity concerns now? Tom?
Tom Reynolds: Embedding throughput could be the bottleneck if they batch vs streaming. If they batch >1000 vectors/min we should recommend dedicated capacity or batching optimizations.
Jae Kim: I'll prepare a 30-min enablement deck and a 15-min quickstart for devs. Link to draft here: https://redwood.internal/gsuite/cedar-onboard-draft (placeholder)
Maria Gomez: Nice. I'll create the calendar invites and pre-read. Please add 5 example prompts to the doc before the sync.
eng-bot: Created calendar event "Cedar Health Onboarding — Internal Prep" for 2026-03-24 09:00 PST. Guests: Maria Gomez, Jae Kim, Tom Reynolds, Lina Patel.
Tom Reynolds: Quick note with calendar snippet to paste into customer invite:
```
When: Tue, Mar 24 · 09:00–09:45 PST
Where: Zoom (link to follow)
Agenda: 1) Intros 2) Integration checklist 3) Embeddings & perf 4) Next steps
```
Lina Patel: I'll draft the 30-day healthboard and share in the #cs-tools channel by EOD.
Jae Kim: Prep items assigned: Tom — integration guide + perf checklist; Lina — success board + prompts; Maria — customer invite + kickoff agenda; me — enablement deck.
Maria Gomez: Perfect. If no objections I will invite Rajesh and Priya after our internal prep tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Tom Reynolds: :thumbsup:
Lina Patel: :thumbsup:
Jae Kim: See you tomorrow, team.
Maria Gomez: thanks — closing the thread for now, will post customer invite link after internal sync.
